name: git-tools-as
description: Android Studio style Git tool window for VS Code: commit panel with checkboxes, log with branch graph, branches popup, push/pull dialogs, stashes, shelf, patches and AI commit messages (Claude / Gemini).

commands.title: Copy Patch of Ticked Files to Clipboard
Bisect: Show First Bad Commit in Log
AI Commit Message: Set API Key…
AI Commit Message: Remove API Key…

gitTools.repositoryScanMaxDepth.description: How many folder levels below each workspace folder are scanned for nested Git repositories (0 = only the workspace folders).

gitTools.log.maxCommits.description: Maximum number of commits loaded in the Log.

gitTools.autoRefresh.description: Refresh automatically when files or the .git folder change.

gitTools.ai.provider.markdownDescription: Service used to generate commit messages. The API key is stored in VS Code Secret Storage via **Git Tools: AI Commit Message: Set API Key…**. See **Git Tools: AI Commit Message: Setup Guide**.

gitTools.ai.claudeModel.markdownDescription: Claude model id, for example `claude-opus-5-5`, `claude-sonnet-5-5` or `claude-haiku-5-5`.

gitTools.ai.geminiModel.markdownDescription: Gemini model id, for example `gemini-3.8-flash` or `gemini-3.5-flash-lite`.

gitTools.ai.language.description: Language of generated messages (e.g. English, Vietnamese). Empty follows the repository history.

gitTools.ai.instructions.description: Extra instructions for generated messages, e.g. "Use Conventional Commits".

gitTools.detectSubmodules.description: List initialized submodules as repositories in Source Control Repositories.

gitTools.submodules.updateOnPull.description: After Update Project / Pull, run "git submodule update --init --recursive" when the repository has submodules.

gitTools.inlineBlame.enabled.description: Show the author, date and summary of the last commit that changed the line with the cursor, after the line.

gitTools.branchPrefixes.description: Prefixes offered when creating a branch (the last used one first). Empty: a plain name box.
